result.summary: One visual defect: the promotional banner's headline and subtext are white on a pale mint background and are barely readable. The rest of the page (header, search, chips, carousels, popular list, bottom nav) renders correctly.

issues.description: The promo banner text, '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10', is white on a very light mint-green background. Contrast is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer and promo code are nearly invisible. Only the 'Order now' button stands out, which suggests the banner's intended darker background or dark text styling failed to apply.
issues.suggestion: Restore the intended banner styling: either use a darker, saturated green background behind the white text, or switch the text to a dark color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light mint background. Aim for at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for the large headline.
